name: marceltov
description: Marcel's curated set of most-used Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: ccp
plugins.description: Code Collaboration Platform toolkit: the ship-pr skill ships uncommitted work end to end (branch, commit, PR, an ADR when architecturally significant, and a merge that only happens after you explicitly confirm it), the resolve-conflicts skill syncs a branch with its target and resolves conflicts into a mergeable state, the triage-issues skill fetches and ranks open issues/project items and hands a picked one to ship-pr, and /issues, /actions, /prs, /pr, /repo and /project commands open the matching GitHub or GitLab view via gh or glab.

plugins.name: engineering-conventions
plugins.description: Marcel Bruckner's engineering conventions (architecture, code, repository setup, stacks) and the working rules every session gets at its start: small tool output, narrow reads and searches, no unasked subagents, short replies. Skills to apply the conventions and to add to them.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Teaches Claude brainstorming, subagent-driven development with built-in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD. Also teaches Claude how to author and test new skills.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Upstash Context7 MCP server for up-to-date documentation lookup. Pulls version-specific docs and code examples straight from source repositories into context. Works anonymously; set CONTEXT7_API_KEY for higher rate limits.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Browser automation and end-to-end testing MCP server by Microsoft, as a headed and a headless instance. Enables Claude to interact with web pages, take screenshots, fill forms, click elements, and perform automated browser testing workflows.

plugins.name: notefeed
plugins.description: MCP server for notefeed: markdown notes and RSS. Post from where you need it, follow where you want.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, or benchmark skill performance with variance analysis.

plugins.name: superdesign
plugins.description: Design or redesign frontend UI and marketing graphics on the Superdesign infinite canvas. Reads your codebase for context, sets up a design system, and generates branchable design drafts you refine.

plugins.name: trilium
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for Trilium Notes: skills for working with your notes, plus the MCP connection to a running Trilium Notes MCP server.

plugins.name: trilium-llm-wiki
plugins.description: Build and maintain an LLM wiki in Trilium Notes after Karpathy's pattern: you collect sources, Claude writes interlinked summary, concept, entity and hub pages, answers from them and lints them. Includes the MCP connection setup.

plugins.name: paperless-ngx
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for Paperless-ngx: skills for cleaning up the inbox, removing duplicates, unlocking encrypted PDFs, searching and editing metadata, plus the MCP connection to a running Paperless-ngx MCP server.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Shape Claude Code output for an ADHD reader: lead with the next action, number steps, suppress tangents, restate state, make wins visible.

plugins.name: notfair
plugins.description: The official ads, analytics, SEO, and GEO plugin from NotFair. Operate Google, Meta, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and TikTok Ads; WordPress and GoHighLevel; analyze Google Search Console and GA4; and run open-source search and content workflows.
